item.description:
inklet Portal for macOS 0.2.0
The first release of the native macOS app, replacing the Electron client.
Highlights - Sends go through inklet's Content → Analysis → Presentation pipeline. The send button offers Just upload, Make a card, Make a card using my recent notes, and Show it as-is; a target picker chooses between letting inklet pick, a paired display, or a Virtual Display. - Home follows each run live with what inklet is doing. - Virtual Displays: create them, publish text or images, and show them on the desktop with the Virtual Display widget. Quick Send and Activity widgets are included. - Display pages show full history, can advance the queue, and can put an earlier card back on screen. - Sign in with a password, Google, or Apple. - Automatic updates: "Check for Updates…" in the application menu, with settings under Settings → General → Updates. - Settings that reach the system: launch at login, show in Dock (with a menu bar item), notifications for delivered, failed, and offline, and weather on Home. - Universal build for Apple silicon and Intel, Developer ID signed and notarized.
Requirements - macOS 26.

item.title: 0.2.0-beta.3
item.description:
inklet Portal for macOS 0.2.0 Beta 3
Changes since 0.2.0 Beta 2 - Display pages read their history and switch what is showing through the new Presentation API: Show Next reports an empty queue honestly, and any earlier card can be put back on the display. - Settings now do what they say: Launch at login, Show in Dock (with a menu bar item), system notifications for delivered, failed, and offline, and weather on Home. - Settings tabs are ordered General, Notifications, Account, About.
Known limitations - Requires macOS 26.
